stt-single-gpu.note: Single GPU. ml.g7/ml.g7e only exist in versions published after the g7 rollout; the script verifies against the package's own supported list.

flux-single-gpu.note: Flux has no kernel for the T4 (sm_75) GPU in ml.g4dn. A g4dn endpoint can reach InService and return empty or garbage transcripts, so it is excluded.

tts-multi-gpu.note: Aura-2 needs 2+ GPUs on one instance; single-GPU types fail at model load.

flux-tts-single-gpu.note: Single GPU, ml.g6 is the floor. Neither g5 nor g4dn is supported.

products.listing_name: Deepgram Voice AI Nova-3 Monolingual Speech-to-Text (STT) Streaming
products.language_param: per-version: pick a language the chosen version carries (e.g. en); the version title lists them
products.use_when: Live audio (calls, meetings, voice UIs) in ONE known language. Each version of this listing covers a set of languages; the endpoint serves the languages in the version you deploy.
gotchas: Streaming listing: InvokeEndpoint (synchronous HTTP) returns 400 'No such model/language/tier'. Use InvokeEndpointWithBidirectionalStream, or deploy the Batch listing for HTTP.
language must be one the deployed version carries; an unknown language closes the stream in ~1s with no transcript.
Bidirectional streaming client MUST connect to port 8443 (runtime.sagemaker.<region>.amazonaws.com:8443). Port 443 hangs forever with no error.

products.listing_name: Deepgram Voice AI Nova-3 Monolingual Speech-to-Text (STT) Batch
products.language_param: per-version: pick a language the chosen version carries (e.g. en)
products.use_when: Pre-recorded audio in ONE known language. Files up to 25 MB per request via InvokeEndpoint on a real-time endpoint. Asynchronous endpoints (InvokeEndpointAsync, up to 1 GB) are temporarily not supported for Marketplace-hosted Deepgram; contact a Deepgram representative if you need them.
gotchas: Asynchronous endpoints are TEMPORARILY NOT SUPPORTED for Marketplace-hosted Deepgram. Deploy real-time and use InvokeEndpoint; for files over 25 MB or an async use case, contact a Deepgram representative.
Deepgram query parameters ride in CustomAttributes as 'v1/listen?model=nova-3&language=en&...'. The path prefix is mandatory.

products.listing_name: Deepgram Voice AI Nova-3 Multilingual Speech-to-Text (STT) Streaming
products.use_when: Live audio where speakers may switch languages mid-conversation, or the language is unknown up front.
gotchas: REQUIRES language=multi. language=en (or any specific code) returns 400 / closes the stream with no transcript — the endpoint is fine, the request is wrong.
Streaming listing: synchronous InvokeEndpoint returns 400. Use bidirectional streaming on port 8443.

products.listing_name: Deepgram Voice AI Nova-3 Multilingual Speech-to-Text (STT) Batch
products.use_when: Pre-recorded audio with mixed or unknown languages.
gotchas: Asynchronous endpoints are TEMPORARILY NOT SUPPORTED for Marketplace-hosted Deepgram. Deploy real-time and use InvokeEndpoint; for files over 25 MB or an async use case, contact a Deepgram representative.
REQUIRES language=multi.
Large multilingual bundles can need ModelDataDownloadTimeoutInSeconds above 600; deploy_endpoint.py defaults this listing to 1800.

products.listing_name: Deepgram Voice AI Flux Monolingual STT Streaming
products.language_param: none — Flux selects the model by name; there is no language parameter
products.use_when: Voice agents / conversational turn-taking in English. Flux is a conversational speech recognition model with built-in end-of-turn detection (StartOfTurn / EagerEndOfTurn / EndOfTurn events) on /v2/listen.
gotchas: Flux is on /v2/listen with a turn-based protocol (TurnInfo events), not /v1/listen. A /v1/listen client gets 400.
Streaming only: no InvokeEndpoint / InvokeEndpointAsync.
encoding=linear16 and sample_rate are required query parameters.
Not supported on ml.g4dn (T4).

products.listing_name: Deepgram Voice AI Flux Multilingual STT Streaming
products.language_param: none — model=flux-general-multi selects the multilingual model; do NOT send language=
products.use_when: Voice agents / conversational turn-taking in multiple languages.
gotchas: Select with model=flux-general-multi. There is NO language parameter; sending one is a 400.
Flux is on /v2/listen; streaming only; encoding+sample_rate required; not on ml.g4dn.

products.language_param: voice is chosen by model=aura-2-<voice>-<lang>; the version you deploy determines which languages' voices exist
products.use_when: Text-to-speech. One listing serves BOTH WebSocket streaming (Speak/Flush/Close messages) and synchronous HTTP (POST JSON {"text": ...}) from the same endpoint.
gotchas: Needs a multi-GPU instance (ml.*.12xlarge). Single-GPU types fail at model load.
Sync HTTP body is JSON {"text": "..."} with ContentType application/json and CustomAttributes 'v1/speak?model=aura-2-thalia-en&encoding=linear16&sample_rate=24000'.
Streaming: send {"type":"Speak","text":...} then {"type":"Flush"}; audio arrives as binary frames; {"type":"Close"} ends the session.

products.use_when: Turn-based text-to-speech for voice agents on /v2/speak (Speak … Flush per turn, Interrupt supported). Same endpoint serves streaming and synchronous HTTP.
gotchas: API path is v2/speak, not v1/speak.
Single GPU; ml.g6 is the floor — g5 and g4dn are not supported.
/v2/speak rejects unknown query parameters with 400 rather than ignoring them.
`speed` is not a flux-tts parameter.

instance_pools_guidance: Deploy with an ordered pool (default_pool) rather than one type: SageMaker falls back to the next type when the first has no capacity. Priority 1 = recommended type; then same-or-newer generation with similar per-instance capacity; older generations last as insurance. Every type in the pool needs quota >= 1 (quota does not fall back). See references/instance-pools.md.

async_endpoints.note: Asynchronous inference (AsyncInferenceConfig / InvokeEndpointAsync) is temporarily not supported for Marketplace-hosted Deepgram endpoints. If you have an async use case, reach out to a Deepgram representative. The scripts refuse --async-bucket / --mode async.
